test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Mobile phones or smartphones are becoming popular all over the world.

B. But at the same time, it also harms us in many ways.

C. It is the most widely used means of communication today.

D. Today, it is very affordable and available to everyone.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the popularity and impact of mobile phones or smartphones.
 
• **Sentence A is the first sentence** as it introduces the main topic:
 
 
• "Mobile phones or smartphones are becoming popular all over the world."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it explains why they are so popular:
 
 
• "It is the most widely used means of communication today."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D is the third sentence** because it highlights their affordability and accessibility:
 
 
• "Today, it is very affordable and available to everyone."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B is the fourth** as it addresses the negative aspects:
 
 
• "But at the same time, it also harms us in many ways."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **ACDB**.
